title: The Last Echo
author: Sebastian Marchetti
blurb: Mirabel Voss, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
